data.name: Imaan
data.gender_notes: Imaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Imaan signifies having faith and belief in the principles of Islam. It is derived from the Arabic root that means to believe or have faith. The name Imaan carries the meaning “Faith and Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Imaan usually hope their child will grow to embody faith and belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Imaan is mentioned as a crucial aspect of a Muslim's life, emphasizing the importance of having strong faith and conviction.
data.etymology: Imaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith and Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imaan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إيمان
in_arabic.meaning: الإيمان بالله والرسول والكتاب والآخرة والقدر خيره وشره
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإيمان هو التصديق بالقلب واللسان لله ولرسوله وللكتاب والآخرة والقدر، وهو أصل الدين الإسلامي، جاء في القرآن الكريم: 'وَمَا كُنتُ بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعدِي وَلا بِمَلَكٍ إِن كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَسْتَخْتَرتُ عَلَيهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَادَامَ عَقَلِي'

in_urdu.name: ایمان
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ اور اس کے رسول اور کتاب اور آخرت اور تقدیر پر یقین
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمان اللہ اور اس کے رسول اور کتاب اور آخرت اور تقدیر کے خیر و شر پر یقین ہے، یہ اسلامی دین کی بنیاد ہے، قرآن مجید میں آیا ہے: 'وَمَا كُنتُ بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعدِي وَلا بِمَلَكٍ إِن كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَسْتَخْتَرتُ عَلَيهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَادَامَ عَقَلِي'

in_hindi.name: ईमान
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान और उसके दूत और पुस्तक और अंत और भाग्य पर विश्वास
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईमान भगवान और उसके दूत और पुस्तक और अंत और भाग्य के अच्छे और बुरे पर विश्वास है, यह इस्लामी धर्म की मूल बात है, कुरआन में आया है: 'وَمَا كُنتُ بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعدِي وَلا بِمَلَكٍ إِن كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَسْتَخْتَرتُ عَلَيهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَادَامَ عَقَلِي'

in_pashto.name: ایمان
in_pashto.meaning: الله او د هغه د رسول او کتاب او اخرت او تقدیر په اړه باور
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمان د الله او د هغه د رسول او کتاب او اخرت او تقدیر د خیر او شر په اړه باور دی، دا د اسلامي دین اساس دی، قرآنکریم کې راغلي: 'وَمَا كُنتُ بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعدِي وَلا بِمَلَكٍ إِن كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَسْتَخْتَرتُ عَلَيهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَادَامَ عَقَلِي'

in_english.name: Imaan
in_english.meaning: Faith and Belief in Allah and His Messenger and the Quran
in_english.long_meaning: Imaan is the faith and belief in Allah, His Messenger, the Quran, the Hereafter, and the decree of Allah. It is the foundation of Islam. The term 'Imaan' is derived from the Arabic root 'أ-م-ن' which conveys the meaning of faith, trust, and safety. In the Quran, Imaan is mentioned as a fundamental aspect of a believer's life, e.g., 'And they, in their turn, shall not escape' (Quran 7:36). Imaan is considered a vital component of a Muslim's personality, encompassing spiritual growth, moral values, and righteous actions.

data.cultural_impact: The term Imaan is deeply embedded in the Islamic culture, it signifies not only belief and faith in Allah but also in the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Islamic community. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining good character, honesty, and integrity. Imaan is also reflected in daily practices, such as prayer and fasting, which strengthen the bonds between individuals and their faith as well as their community.
data.spiritual_significance: Imaan has profound spiritual significance for Muslims. It represents the inner connection between an individual and their Creator, and emphasizes the importance of maintaining this relationship throughout one's life. Having imaan allows one to lead a purposeful and fulfilling life, guided by the principles of Islam. It also provides a sense of peace and tranquility, knowing that one's beliefs and actions are in alignment with the will of God. Ultimately, imaan is a continuous process of growth, requiring commitment, dedication, and perseverance, as one strives to deepen their faith and draw closer to Allah.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Imaan ibn Husain was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the ten promised Paradise. The name Imaan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Imaan was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is considered a martyr for his faith.
